name: Cutler Bay
seo_title: Christmas Events for Kids in Cutler Bay, FL 2026
seo_desc: Kids' Christmas in Cutler Bay, FL: the town's Holiday Golf Cart Parade and toy drive, plus The Nutcracker at the Moss Center.
lede: Cutler Bay celebrates Christmas with a free evening at Cutler Ridge Park built around a golf cart parade and a toy drive, and with ballet at the Moss Center. The town's Parks and Recreation Department runs its signature events.
celebrates: The Town of Cutler Bay's Parks and Recreation Department coordinates its special events, and the holiday highlight is the Holiday Celebration and Golf Cart Parade at Cutler Ridge Park, 10100 SW 200 Street. Families come for photos with Santa, food trucks, inflatables, face painting, music and a toy drive for children in need, then watch decorated golf carts roll by. Nearby, the Dennis C. Moss Cultural Arts Center at 10950 SW 211 Street hosts holiday performances, and its Miami Youth Ballet Nutcracker is a family favorite.
lastyear: In 2025 the town held its Holiday Celebration and Golf Cart Parade on Saturday, December 13, from 6 to 10 pm at Cutler Ridge Park, with free admission. The activities included photos with Santa, food trucks, holiday inflatables, face painters, a toy drive, the parade and music. Toys collected were planned for donation to Community Health of South Florida. Golf cart lineup opened at 5 pm, and the parade was set to begin promptly at 6 pm.
facts: Cutler Bay's town hall is at 10720 Caribbean Boulevard, and Cutler Ridge Park sits at 10100 SW 200 Street. The town's special events page lists signature events through the year, including a Halloween Spooktacular, an Easter Eggstravaganza, a Hispanic Heritage celebration, a Veterans Day Breakfast and a 4th of July Parade and Picnic. For the 2025 holiday parade, the lineup was planned to close once 300 golf carts had lined up, whichever came first.
trains: Cutler Bay has no train station of its own. The nearest Metrorail stop is Dadeland South, at 9090 South Dixie Highway, which Miami-Dade Transit lists as the southernmost station on the Green Line. Families who want to see real rail cars can visit the Gold Coast Railroad Museum at 12450 SW 152nd Street in Miami, which has a small Link train, a model train building and historic railroad cars.
train_links: Train rides, rail cars and a model train building at 12450 SW 152nd Street in Miami.
traditions: Decorated golf carts line up at Cutler Ridge Park and roll out in an evening parade.
Families donate new unwrapped toys, which the town has planned to give to Community Health of South Florida.
The town's holiday celebration has included pictures with Santa.
The evening also has food trucks, holiday inflatables, face painters and music.
The Nutcracker at the Moss Center
Miami Youth Ballet and professional dancers perform The Nutcracker on the Moss Center stage.
kidfact: Cutler Bay's parade can have up to 300 golf carts, so the street fills with decorated carts instead of floats.
faq: Where is the Cutler Bay golf cart parade?

The town's Holiday Celebration and Golf Cart Parade is at Cutler Ridge Park, 10100 SW 200 Street, Cutler Bay. In 2025 the lineup opened at 5 pm in the West Soccer Field and the parade began at 6 pm. The town posts the current year's flyer and route map on its Parks and Recreation page.
Is the Cutler Bay holiday celebration free?

In 2025 the town listed free admission to the Holiday Celebration and Golf Cart Parade, with a toy drive at the park. Families brought new unwrapped toys to donate. The town's special events page lists the current year's event, so check there for the latest details and parade participation rules.
Can my family ride in the golf cart parade?

The town asks anyone who wants to participate to read its Parade Participation Rules before the event. In 2025 the lineup closed at 5:50 pm, or sooner once 300 golf carts had lined up. Contact the Parks and Recreation Department for sponsorship, vendor or parade questions.

The Dennis C. Moss Cultural Arts Center, known as the Moss Center, is at 10950 SW 211 Street in Cutler Bay. Its box office number is 786-573-5300. The center says all patrons need a ticket, including infants, and strollers are not permitted inside the auditorium.
What toys does the Cutler Bay toy drive take?

In 2025 the town asked families to donate new unwrapped toys and said they would go to Community Health of South Florida. Check the town's current event page for any change in donation details and for drop off instructions on the night of the celebration.
